values.website: An ultra-compact serial-to-IP gateway on MT7628 with RS485, optional Wi-Fi 4, and a single Fast Ethernet port for bridging field devices to IP networks in DIN-rail enclosures.

Energy Meter & Utility Device Integration
Building Automation Connectivity
Legacy Device Network Enablement
